pages.title: First playback
pages.text: Speakers play uploaded MP3 or WAV files.$(br2)Stay within their audible range.$(br2)Speakers and proxies ignore direct redstone; use a linked Speaker Controller for automation.

pages.title: Dependencies
pages.text: Install matching Simply Speakers, Architectury, OpenUI and Patchouli versions.$(br2)Fabric also needs Fabric API.$(br2)Clients and servers must use matching mod versions.
